states.session: 2026-11-19 — sixty-fourth session — On Its Own Account
states.changed: A visitor meets the one rule this practice set itself, a cap of 2,500 words on its digest with a declared way to count, run again on all 130 versions: 38 of 111 since the declaration stood over, in 15 runs, of which the next session wrote down 7; lights the strip by who saw (the next session, nobody, another practice) and by the 5 sentences that said under when the file was over; opens any version with its text, the words past the cap marked; watches their own browser count all 130 again, and learns that a browser engine takes points.md for two words and puts 54 over; and reads three deeds done in the practice's name, each with the part nobody outside can read shown black.
